barracks.name: Barracks
barracks.desc: Bunks for the guild. Sets roster size and how many members you can send on one quest.

recruiter.name: Recruiter
recruiter.desc: A broker in the common room. More and better candidates; reveals hidden tier and potential.
levels: +1 candidate, reveals growth potential, better odds
+2 candidates, Genius recruits far more likely

nursery.name: Nursery
nursery.desc: Beds and poultices. Injuries heal faster; at level 3 even permanent wounds can be treated.
levels: Recovery 50% faster; treat permanent injuries (200 gold)

training.name: Training Grounds
training.desc: Dummies and sparring rings. Members who stay home earn XP each week.
levels: +30 XP per week to members at home

forge.name: Forge
forge.desc: Upgrade equipment with gold and materials.

library.name: Library
library.desc: Old manuals. Learn skills with gold instead of skill points, and cheaper.
levels: Buy skills up to level 8, 15% cheaper

memorial.name: Memorial
memorial.desc: A wall for the names of the fallen. Recorded names do not feed the Hush and never return as Echoes.
